functions.name: upsert-record
functions.description: Create or partially update one record by an explicitly chosen unique field within a table.

additionalProperties.description: Direct writable value for this field ID.

values.description: Direct writable field-ID values including the unique match value. Omitted fields stay unchanged on update; null clears supported non-match fields; empty text/lists remain explicit. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, datetimes RFC 3339 with offset and at most milliseconds, durations milliseconds. Files use fileName and base64 data for exact binary bytes.

tableId.description: Table dbid that scopes the match.

matchFieldId.description: Supported unique field ID used to match; its non-null value must be present in values.

FunctionInput_quickbase_upsertrecord.description: One record to create or partially update using an explicitly selected unique field.

id.description: Opaque Record ID of the created or updated row.

action.description: Actual action reported by Quickbase, not inferred from a preflight read.

tableId.description: Table dbid scoping the result.

FunctionOutput_quickbase_upsertrecord.description: The record identity and actual write action confirmed by Quickbase.

tags.instructions: Use when matching by a supported unique field rather than a known Record ID. Specify matchFieldId and include its value in values. Zero matches create, one match updates, multiple matches fail. Use `create-record` for create-only or `update-record` for known-ID changes. Replay can cause field, attachment or event side effects.
